Metal Casting Services

Solomon Industries LLC specializes in high-quality metal casting services, offering precision die casting, investment casting, and sand casting solutions. Our advanced facilities and experienced team ensure superior quality castings for various industries including automotive, aerospace, and industrial equipment manufacturing.

Advanced Capabilities

Comprehensive Metal Casting Solutions

Our state-of-the-art facilities and experienced team provide a wide range of metal casting services to meet your specific requirements.

Die Casting

High-pressure die casting for aluminum, zinc, and magnesium alloys with tight tolerances and excellent surface finish.

Investment Casting

Precision investment casting for complex geometries and detailed components requiring superior surface quality.

Sand Casting

Traditional and automated sand casting processes for large components and prototype production.

Capabilities & Specifications

Our comprehensive metal casting capabilities allow us to handle projects of various sizes and complexities.

  • Aluminum die casting up to 5kg
  • Zinc die casting up to 2kg
  • Investment casting for steel and stainless steel
  • Sand casting for iron and non-ferrous alloys
  • Secondary operations including machining and surface finishing
  • Quality control and material testing
  • Prototype to high-volume production
